  (let* ((small (compress-grid g))
         (ordered (sort-by (objects small -1)
           (lambda (o)
             (+ (* -10000000 (obj-size o))
                (* 10 (+ (* 29791 (obj-r1 o)) (* 961 (obj-c1 o))

programs.first_nontrivial:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define (key<? a b)
    (cond ((empty? a) #f) ((< (first a) (first b)) #t)
          ((> (first a) (first b)) #f) (else (key<? (rest a) (rest b)))))
  (define rs (cons 0 (filter (lambda (r) (not (equal? (nth g r) (nth g (- r 1))))) (range 1 (rows g)))))
  (define cs (cons 0 (filter (lambda (c) (any? (lambda (r) (!= (at g r c) (at g r (- c 1)))) (range (rows g)))) (range 1 (cols g)))))
  (define hs (map - (append (rest rs) (list (rows g))) rs))
  (define ws (map - (append (rest cs) (list (cols g))) cs))
  (define rpick rs)
  (define cpick cs)
  (define logical (grid-from-fn (length rpick) (length cpick) (lambda (r c) (at g (nth rpick r) (nth cpick c)))))
  (define all-os (objects logical -1))
  (define nonsingletons (filter (lambda (o) (> (obj-size o) 1)) all-os))
  (define os (if (empty? nonsingletons) all-os nonsingletons))
  (define (key o) (append (obj-bbox o) (list (obj-color o))))
  (if (empty? os) logical (let ((chosen (first (sort os (lambda (a b) (key<? (key a) (key b))))))) (crop-object logical chosen)))))
